sourceReferences: scripts/trajectory_p2d2/l2-gate.mjs (real DSH boot + DSH's own persistence read)
host/deployment/runtime/session_reader.js (the official read path, reused by the product)
method: the real first-party DSH Host is booted with a TEST-OWNED DETERMINISTIC LOCAL LLM ADAPTER that performs NO I/O, then the persisted session is read through DSH's OWN persistence and the `user/message` events are extracted and digested
whyNotRequestHeader: `request/header` is a header snapshot (tools/model) and does NOT carry the message text; DSH's model-visible surface event is `user/message`, which projects `content` verbatim. The gate reads `user/message` directly

observedResults.byteDeltaExplained: the 352-byte section plus the single blank-line separator

providerActivity.adapter: a test-owned deterministic local adapter that performs no I/O and opens no socket
providerActivity.note: the ONLY adapter mounted is the local deterministic one; no credential exists in the test-owned profile, and the adapter's stream() performs no network call

expectedInvariant: the ACTUAL DSH Session records the intended `user/message` content, and under TREATMENT that content carries the qualified Trajectory Section while under OFF it does not
remainingUncertainty: L2 proves the SESSION recorded the intended bytes; it does NOT prove a model UNDERSTOOD the section. L3 (real model utility) is explicitly out of scope
